provenance: Four original procedural illustrations drawn with this Python source, no external image or font assets.

scenes.name: architecture
scenes.prompt: architectural illustration, steel truss bridge in side elevation, straight horizontal dark girders, repeated triangular braces, muted blue and warm gray, water below
scenes.fidelity_criteria: Follow straight girders and repeating diagonal braces across both centre lines; check for broken lines, doubling, invented braces or missing spans.

scenes.name: organic
scenes.prompt: botanical illustration, overlapping diagonal fern fronds, rows of individual serrated green leaflets with delicate central veins against a dark green ground
scenes.fidelity_criteria: Follow the pale diagonal frond through the centre; compare leaflet count, pointed teeth, alternating bases and veins, including newly invented or blurred detail.

scenes.name: lettering
scenes.prompt: vintage enamel tide gauge sign, readable cream geometric lettering TIDE 07 on dark blue, narrow ruler ticks below, decorative wave and four corner screws
scenes.fidelity_criteria: Read TIDE 07, including the centred E crossbar, compare narrow ruler ticks, four screws and wave detail; count changes as fidelity failures even with smooth seams.

scenes.name: subject
scenes.prompt: illustrated koi fish in blue water, one cream fish swimming to the lower left, four red patches, diagonal body, two pale fins and a forked tail
scenes.fidelity_criteria: Trace one fish outline across both central boundaries, four patches, scale arcs, eye, two fins and tail fork; distinguish new detail from changed anatomy.
